cases.purpose: Establishes the digest for a compact object source.
Member order and insignificant source whitespace do not change the digest.
Boolean and null values remain valid portable values and are not converted to strings.
JCS emits the required escaping for quotes, backslashes, and control characters.
Unicode scalar values are preserved without normalization.
Unicode escape spelling and literal UTF-8 spelling produce the same scalar values.
ASCII object member names use the exact JCS order.
Duplicate object member names are rejected before parser overwrite can occur.
An unescaped control character makes the source invalid JSON.
An unpaired UTF-16 surrogate is not an I-JSON string value.
Portable hashable values reject JSON numbers even when the value is integral.
Portable hashable objects reject non-ASCII member names.
Locks the one-shot Authorization Scope ID for one complete Principal Authorization.
Changing only the Principal nonce changes the Scope ID.
A second Principal authorizing the same Target has an independent Scope.
Changing only the Core Deployment changes the Scope ID.
Changing only the chain reference changes the Scope ID.
Changing only the Market in the ordered Target changes the Scope ID.
Changing only the Engine Revision changes the Scope ID.
Changing only the Liquidity Domain Revision changes the Scope ID.
Changing only the binding Scope domain separator changes the Scope ID.
Changing only an asset debit limit changes the Scope ID.
Changing only the deadline changes the Scope ID.
Locks a stored Scope identity that persists across cumulative partial fills.
Changing only the Principal nonce changes the stored Scope identity.
Locks direct one-shot lifecycle identity separately from detached signed authorization.
Locks a fee-funding Principal Scope to one exact assessment Scope, Principal, asset tuple, ceiling, and Collector.
Changing only the sponsored gross-assessment maximum changes the sponsor Scope identity.
The same Asset Profile and native asset tuple cannot carry conflicting limits twice.
The same assessment Scope and asset tuple cannot carry two sponsor ceilings.
A sponsored assessment record must use an asset tuple authorized by the fee-funding Principal.
The sponsor ceiling cannot exceed its matching per-asset assessment or total debit limit.

relations.purpose: Equivalent object values have equal digests despite source member order and whitespace.
Equivalent Unicode scalar values have equal digests regardless of source escape spelling.
